objective: Test column-height XOR plus stone-count parity as a rank-local structural coordinate, derivational lens for R/F/G/H safe forgetting, ambiguity classifier, and QF/QA/QV candidate without assuming it is fundamental.

frozen_candidate.X: bitwise XOR of current column heights
frozen_candidate.p: sum of current column heights mod 2
frozen_candidate.relation_to_test: p may be redundant with the least-significant bit of X; test and record rather than treating the pair as independent

questions: Does X,p determine or materially simplify M/R/F/G/H deletion decisions?
Can X,p resolve any of the 836 previously observed same-future transition-representation splits?
Is X,p sufficient for QF, QA, or QV on any complete bounded case?
Does adding X,p refine q_SigmaRFG or is it already derivable from retained support?
What neighboring symmetric support reductions outperform or falsify the XOR hypothesis?
What part of X,p is recursively maintainable from a move?
alternatives: exact owned residuals combined with reduced support descriptors
anti_circularity: candidate keys use current position/G only
solved values/future classes are derived only after candidate definitions are frozen
future-derived quotient classes are evaluation oracles, never candidate definitions
the 836 ambiguity target is reproduced independently from the old M/R/F/C normal form
